prompt: Write ONE plastron formula that builds a piano-style musical keyboard that LOOKS like a keyboard: a row of white note keys (C D E F G A B) sized and bordered like piano keys, each a clickable button that plays its tone via origin.tone. When a key is pressed it should visibly change colour. Use the verbs in the guide. Output only the formula (or a #raw= link), nothing else.
Write ONE plastron formula that renders a simple solar-system model: the sun and a few planets as circles, drawn on a canvas (or as dom). Output only the formula (or a #raw= link), nothing else.
Write ONE plastron formula that makes a small spreadsheet of data (a few labeled rows with numbers) and draws a bar chart of those numbers. Output only the formula (or a #raw= link), nothing else.

Write ONE plastron formula for an invoice line: given price in A1 and quantity in A2, compute the subtotal, 13% tax, and grand total. Use LET so the subtotal is named and not recomputed, and return the grand total. Output only the formula (or a #raw= link), nothing else.

Write ONE plastron formula that makes a sheet with the numbers 1..6 in a column and, in another cell of the SAME sheet, computes the sum of their squares using MAP and LAMBDA. Output only the formula (or a #raw= link), nothing else.

Write ONE plastron formula that makes a sheet with a column of daily amounts and, in adjacent cells, shows the running total using SCAN with a LAMBDA. Output only the formula (or a #raw= link), nothing else.

Write ONE plastron formula that makes a small grid of numbers (a few rows, a few columns) and computes each row's total in a new column using BYROW with a LAMBDA. Output only the formula (or a #raw= link), nothing else.
Build a small plastron: a clickable button that plays middle C (origin.tone 261.63). Give me a #raw= shareable plastron.ca link that opens it. Output ONLY the link.

Build a small plastron: a clickable button that plays middle C (origin.tone 261.63). Give me a COMPRESSED #f= (base64url) shareable plastron.ca link that opens it. Output ONLY the link, or — if you cannot produce the compressed payload yourself — the exact plastron formula I should run to generate the link.

Build a small plastron: a clickable button that plays middle C (origin.tone 261.63). Give me an AES-256-GCM password-encrypted shareable plastron.ca link for it, password "cels". Output ONLY the link, or — if you cannot encrypt it yourself — the exact plastron formula I should run to generate the link.

Build a small plastron: a clickable button that plays middle C (origin.tone 261.63). Give me a one-time-pad (OTP / Vernam) encrypted shareable plastron.ca link for it, using the plastron card image as the pad. Output ONLY the link, or — if you cannot encrypt it yourself — the exact plastron formula I should run to generate the link.

Build a navigation menu for a plastron desktop: top-level entries for Files, a Charts menu with two nested chart options (a pie chart and a bar chart, each generating a small data sheet+chart when clicked), and an entry that focuses the origin (元) window. It must work on BOTH mobile and desktop. Output only the formula (or a #raw= link), nothing else.
